karen: Opening expedited hotfix for encoder routing (intermittent 5xx on batched long requests). Built encoder:v1.10.2-hotfix. No DB changes. Requesting lifeboat 10%->50%->100% in 25m. /cc @matt_p @oncall-oliver

matt_p: Paste deploy link + rollback steps. confirm smoke tests.

karen: Deploy: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1768809999. Smoke tests green in staging. Rollback plan:
```bash
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/encoder encoder=redwood/encoder:v1.10.1
curl -X POST https://release-config.internal/pin -d '{"service":"encoder", "version":"v1.10.1", "reason": "rollback"}'
```
No kv-cache touch. I'll add playbook to #eng-oncall.

deploybot: Deploy request received for encoder:v1.10.2-hotfix. CI: ✅ unit ✅ integration e2e flaky. Proposed canary 10% for 4m, auto-pause if error_rate >0.9% for 2m. Reply "approve" or react :thumbsup:.

oncall-oliver: I'll be on pager for 60m. OK with expedited if 4m gate and rollback owner. Enabling verbose traces. +1

matt_p: Adding circuit-breaker: threshold=0.9%, window=2m, p95 alert +12%.

karen: thresholds added. Starting canary now.

deploybot: Canary started at 1768810005 -> encoder:v1.10.2 @10%. Link: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1768809999/canary

oncall-oliver: 3m in: error_rate 0.2%, p95 stable. Proceed to 50%.

deploybot: Ramp to 50% at 1768810035.

matt_p: 50% steady. p95 +1%, error_rate 0.15%.

deploybot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1768810050.

karen: No rollback needed. Publishing RN-523 and tagging post-release followups. Thanks all. :rocket:

releasebot: RN-523 published. Ledger L-10234 marked expedited.
